name: Merge Rainbow Friend
storyline: There is no official narrative. The gameplay focuses on merging characters and strategy mechanics rather than storytelling.
summary:
Merge Rainbow Friend invites you to dive into an enthralling world of color and strategy, presenting you with a dynamic puzzle-battler that captivates and excels in both its simplicity and depth. In this vibrant arena, you'll find a spectrum of unique monster companions awaiting your command, ready to amalgamate and evolve, pressing you to outwit and overcome increasingly challenging adversaries.

Your primary goal is to strategically merge your monster friends, combining identical units to spawn powerful creatures with enhanced abilities. Skillfully maneuvering these monsters on the board and mastering combinations will dictate success in the combat phase, where tactical decisions pay off as you face down enemy forces.
